{{Top|leg}}
On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]], each clan was led by a '''Council of Elders'''. The clan councils met twice a year in the ceremonial [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Barimoq Crater]]. During the meetings, they debated and made changes to the Tasari legal codes about relating to dealing with off-worlders.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
